reply: Thank you for explaining that an account on your credit profile is reported inaccurately and that you want it reinvestigated. We understand your concern about accuracy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please describe exactly which details of the account are wrong and include supporting documents. If the company that supplied it finds it was wrong, it must tell every credit reporting company it reported to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a bankruptcy entry was verified as accurate even though you have documents showing it was removed elsewhere as unverifiable, and that you asked how it was verified. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team, including your request for the method of reinvestigation. Please keep copies of your dispute, the response and the other documentation together. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that inquiries appear on your report for credit transactions you did not start. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Reports may only be shared with companies that have a permissible purpose, so please list each inquiry you did not authorize and dispute it in writing, keeping copies of what you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a charge-off or collection appears on your credit report without notice, and that you have asked for validation and tax documents. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Collectors must give you certain information about a debt, so keep a copy of your validation request and the date it was sent, and continue to send any dispute in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute a debt that you believe is incorrect or already paid, and that you did not receive validation information before it was reported. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Sending your dispute in writing, ideally within 30 days of the first notice, helps protect your rights. Please keep copies of your dispute and any proof of payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you only now learned of a judgment from many years ago and are being warned about wage garnishment, and that you have been a victim of identity theft. We understand how alarming this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for the details of the debt and the judgment, and keep your police and identity theft reports ready. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a former partner used your information to open accounts in your name, and that you have filed a police report. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please report the identity theft through the federal identity theft website, send that report and your police report to each lender, and review your credit reports for other accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collector keeps contacting you about bills that are not yours from a state where you have never lived, and that you have a police report. We understand how tiring this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep good records of every contact, and send the collector a written dispute with your police report asking them to stop contacting you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts and inquiries on your credit report were opened or made without your authorization. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please check your statements and reports for other signs of identity theft, report it through the federal identity theft website, and dispute each item with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a letter asking for the payment history, signed contract and other details of a debt, and have not received a response. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your letter and proof of the date it was delivered. If you do not want further contact, you can tell the collector so in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collection account appeared on your credit report without any notice from the collector. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the validation information about the debt, including the original creditor and amount, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector keeps collecting and reporting a debt without validating it or giving you an itemized breakdown. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. If you believe you do not owe the debt, send the collector a written dispute asking for an itemized balance and proof of the original creditor, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector would not give you information about a debt you have disputed, and that you have filed identity theft reports. We understand your frustration, including the blocked store return. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep sending disputes in writing with your identity theft and police reports, and keep copies with the dates sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received only a partial response to your validation request and that the debt is still being reported. We understand your frustration after several follow-ups. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the partial response and your follow-up letters, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies, noting that you dispute the debt. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute an item on your credit report as a misrepresentation of your credit history. We understand you want it corrected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify the item, describe what is inaccurate and include supporting documents. If you disagree with the investigation result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection for a loan you did not apply for appeared on your report, with a balance that grew from $2,500.00 to $4,400.00, despite your fraud alert. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Accounts can be sold and appear under unfamiliar names; please dispute it in writing and ask for a copy of the signed loan agreement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $430.00 collection account remains on your report after your dispute and that you never signed anything with the company. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the validation information, including the original creditor and amount, and keep copies of your requests. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe an item on your credit profile is inaccurate and incomplete, and that you want proof and a description of the procedure used. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify the item and what is wrong with it. If information is deleted, you can ask that notices be sent to those who recently received your report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collector calls you daily about an account you did not open, and that your fraud notes are not being recorded. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send your dispute in writing instead of by phone, ask the collector to identify itself and the original creditor, and keep copies of every letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two medical bills went to collection even though you had insurance and gave your details at each visit. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the provider to bill your insurance and keep your insurance cards and claims records from those dates. Medical bills often depend on how insurance was billed, so ask for an itemized bill. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection for a cancelled service appeared on your report while you are buying a home, even though you returned the equipment and were told your balance was zero. We understand the timing matters. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute with the cancellation confirmation and equipment return receipt, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a debt cancellation notice for an account you thought was closed years ago, without any earlier contact. We understand why this was unexpected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the account records behind the notice, including when the balance arose and the account history, and keep the notice. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a medical bill was sent to the wrong insurer, that payment from the correct insurer is not being accepted, and that the debt is on your report. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please give the provider your correct insurance details in writing and ask it to rebill, and keep copies of your insurance information. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a past-due phone bill was sent to collections though you had autopay, that you paid it to protect your credit, and that the collector says it no longer has the debt. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your payment receipt and autopay records, and dispute the collection entry if it still shows. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a company that bought an old debt is threatening legal action, and that you never received a notice allowing you to dispute it. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute and ask for the validation information about the debt, and keep copies with the date sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt you do not recognize appeared on your credit report without any notice from the collector. We understand your concern about possible fraud. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please do not ignore the collector; send a written dispute asking for the original creditor and the details of the debt, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your debt validation request did not receive the documents you asked for, such as the payment history and the assignment of the debt. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your request and the reply, and dispute the debt again in writing if you believe it is not owed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received texts from a company you do not know and requested verification of the debt, with no reply after 38 days, while it affects your rental assistance. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the texts and a copy of your verification request, and send a dispute by mail as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you dispute the items reported against you and want them verified. We understand your position. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. To help the review, please identify each account you dispute and explain why you believe it is inaccurate, including any documents you have. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a $1,100.00 collection account appears on your credit report without documentation. We understand you want it verified. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written request for the validation information about the debt, and dispute the account with each credit reporting company, keeping copies of everything. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
